proposals.evidence: Full matsya gives Prakrit maccha, Oriya mācha, regional māch/mācho, Marathi māsā and fish forms in -ī. The western matsha/matsho/māṭsi responses and Oriya ma.co fit this base family, preserving spacing, aspiration and affricate spelling without inventing a distinct etymon. Cross-IA transmission is qualified. Exact response: matsho.
